text:
lina: Heads-up — planning a small canary for the new inference-runtime v2 tonight. Target start 00:30 PDT, initial 5% (NA-west + small internal cohort). Need a deployer and a smoke owner. ETA ~2h end-to-end if no issues.

sam: I can deploy. Can we confirm the cohort mapping and ramp table? Also who has the rollback key?

lina: Thanks Sam — cohort CSV attached below (slice,region,weight). Rollback key is with @oncall until 01:30.

-- cohort.csv --
slice,region,weight
alpha,NA-west,0.03
beta,NA-east,0.02
internal-qa,prod-internal,0.0(redirect)

oliver: I'll own smoke checks for the NA regions. Plan: run baseline perf + correctness and TTL/kv-cache sanity. Quick smoke checklist: 1) send 50 short gen requests 2) check p95 < 200ms 3) validate top3 tokens for our canary prompts 4) ensure no 5xx for model routing.

jen: I can cover EU follow-ups and monitor logs/alerts. If any spike in model-error-rate > 1% we pause and rollback.

sam: Deploy runbook notes: 
- deploy command: `./infra/deploy --service inference-runtime --image gcr.io/redwood/runtime:v2-canary --traffic 5%`
- smoke command (NA): ```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize: hello","max_tokens":16}'
```
Expect HTTP 200 and body.tokens.length > 0.

oncall: I have rollback privileges. If we hit any of: sustained 5xxs > 0.5% for 10m, p95 latency > 800ms for 10m, or downstream error alerts — call me and I will cut traffic to the previous image (v1). Rollback command: `./infra/rollback --service inference-runtime --to-tag v1-stable`

deploy-bot: Deploy window assigned: 00:30-02:30 PDT. Notifying stakeholders and locking other concurrent deploys to inference-service during window. CI checks: all green (build 5421). :white_check_mark:

lina: Ramp plan (manual gating): 00:30 start -> 5% (30m smoke), if green -> 20% (30m), if green -> 50% (30m), final -> 100% (monitor 30m). Each step requires :
- smoke owner sign-off in thread (oliver/jen)
- no active alerts on dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.prod/d/inference/runtime-v2

oliver: I'll post the quick smoke run results in the thread. I'll include one-line metrics and the top-of-log tail if anything suspicious. If small token regression, note and hold — we can A/B tweak quantization but not during canary.

jen: FYI — I've scheduled an extra pager coverage from 00:25-02:45.

sam: All set here, I will kick at 00:30. Will ping when the deploy starts and after each ramp step.

lina: :thumbsup: Thanks team. Tagging owners: @sam deployer, @oliver smoke-NA, @jen smoke-EU, @oncall rollback. If anyone needs to swap, shout now.
